issues.problem: Nearly literal ('not enough hands'); in everyday speech 人手が足りない is the usual form. Its meaning line 'to be short-handed' also nearly duplicated ky040 猫の手も借りたい
issues.action: removed; replaced with 足を運ぶ (あしをはこぶ) 'to take the trouble to go somewhere in person', lvl 1, tag effort, under the same id

issues.problem: A literal compound noun phrase that matches the English 'a matter of time' word for word; it is not a real 慣用句 and teaches nothing idiomatic
issues.action: removed; replaced with 目に浮かぶ (めにうかぶ) 'to picture something vividly in one's mind', lvl 1, tag knowledge, under the same id

issues.entry: ky040 猫の手も借りたい
issues.problem: Meaning line 'so short-handed...' could also describe 手が足りない; the idiom is about being frantically busy
issues.action: mean -> 'so busy that any help at all would be welcome'

issues.problem: 'a joke or flattery' was too narrow, and the line was hard to tell apart from ky081 鵜呑みにする; the point is taking seriously something not meant seriously
issues.action: mean -> 'to take at face value what was not meant seriously'

issues.problem: 'wrongdoing' was too narrow; the phrase covers anything one ought to deal with but ignores
issues.action: mean -> 'to look the other way at something one should act on'

issues.problem: 'to show off' overlaps with plain boasting; 見栄を張る is putting on a front to appear better off or more capable
issues.action: mean -> 'to put on a front to look better off than one is'

issues.problem: Meaning line described only the gesture, not what it expresses
issues.action: mean -> 'to be puzzled or doubtful about something'

issues.problem: Checked every reading character by character (e.g. 堪忍袋の緒が切れる かんにんぶくろのおがきれる, 白羽の矢が立つ しらはのやがたつ, 九死に一生を得る きゅうしにいっしょうをえる, 物議を醸す ぶつぎをかもす, 口裏を合わせる くちうらをあわせる, 肩身が狭い かたみがせまい). Checked every form against the standard dictionary form, and checked for overlap with the yoji and kotowaza lists (none). Confirmed 気が置けない carries its correct meaning (at ease with), not the common misreading
